name: @apexmail/testing
description: Visual and migration verification for Rust UI parity

scripts.test:visual: pnpm run prepare:rust:fixtures && pnpm run prepare:playwright && ./node_modules/.bin/playwright test --config=playwright.rust-visual.config.ts
scripts.test:visual:update: pnpm run prepare:rust:fixtures && pnpm run prepare:playwright && ./node_modules/.bin/playwright test --config=playwright.rust-visual.config.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.test:e2e:auth: pnpm run prepare:rust:fixtures && pnpm run prepare:playwright && ./node_modules/.bin/playwright test --config=playwright.auth-flow.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run test:visual && pnpm run test:e2e:auth
